about: The closed list of patterns a clause is tagged with. Edited only in this library; Docs/patterns.md is generated from it (npm run build:patterns). See CONTEXT.md and Docs/adr/0004.

cast.meaning: On the cast or the use itself: the card is posted, the targets are confirmed, or each rolls its save from the card.

sustain.meaning: Each time the caster Sustains the spell.

turn-start.meaning: When a creature starts its turn — in an area, or carrying an effect.
phrases: at the start of its turn
at the start of each of its turns

turn-end.meaning: When a creature ends its turn — in an area, or carrying an effect.
phrases: at the end of each of its turns
at the end of its turn

on-entering.meaning: When a creature moves into an area.

on-moving.meaning: For each move action spent in or into an area, not just the first entry.
phrases: begins to use a move action

while-inside.meaning: For as long as a creature stands in the area; it starts on entering and stops on leaving.

save-made.meaning: When this creature rolls a save against someone else's effect.

strike-received.meaning: When a Strike resolves against this creature.

damage-taken.meaning: When damage from someone else lands on this creature.
phrases: Each time the target is hit

damage-dealt.meaning: When damage from this creature's item lands.

dying.meaning: When a creature nearby would die.

check-rolled.meaning: On a check the holder rolls, before or after the dice: a bonus to spend, a degree to change.
phrases: attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check

reach.question: Who or what does it touch?

up-to-n.meaning: Several chosen targets, up to a count.

area.meaning: Everyone a placed area catches. The variant is its shape, because each shape aims differently.

burst.meaning: A burst, placed at a point in range.

cone.meaning: A cone from the caster's edge, aimed in two clicks.

emanation.meaning: An emanation around the caster or a creature; no aiming.

line.meaning: A line from the caster, aimed in two clicks.

ring.meaning: A ring whose band is the area and whose middle is not.

chain.meaning: A first target, then each next one within a distance of the last.
phrases: within 30 feet of the first target

allies.meaning: The area or effect counts only the caster's allies.

enemies.meaning: The area or effect counts only the caster's enemies.

object.meaning: An object rather than a creature: no area, no catch, or a wall section destroyed.

weapon.meaning: A weapon the caster or target is holding.

filtered.meaning: Only creatures of a kind qualify: a size, a level, living, breathing, flying.

attacker.meaning: The creature that struck or damaged the holder, answered after the blow.
authored: carries: a damage-received rider aimed at the attacker

area.question: If there is an area, how does it behave?

lingering.meaning: The area stays on the board after the cast, as a Region, until its duration ends.

placed-only.meaning: The area is placed and targets nobody at the cast; only what stands in it later matters.

aura.meaning: An area around a creature that moves with it.

pf2e.meaning: pf2e's own Aura rule on an effect.
authored: an effect with an Aura rule

region.meaning: A lingering Region that follows the caster.

grows-on-sustain.meaning: Each Sustain makes the area larger.

moved-on-sustain.meaning: Each Sustain moves the area or the thing in it.

drifts.meaning: The area moves by itself each round.
phrases: moves 10 feet away from you each round

several.meaning: One cast places more than one area.

apart.meaning: The areas of one cast must not overlap, or must stand a distance apart.

zones.meaning: An area with an inner zone that deals something more.
phrases: at the center of its area

shape-choice.meaning: The caster chooses the area's shape or size at the cast, or no area at all.

wall.meaning: A run of sections laid on grid lines or squares.

clear-space.meaning: The area must be placed where no creature or object stands, or the spell is lost.

from-target.meaning: The area starts from a creature other than the caster.

swept.meaning: A moving area reaches everyone whose space it passed over, not only where it stops.

strikes-from.meaning: A lingering area the caster aims a further, smaller strike from — a bolt, a vine.

save.meaning: A save whose degrees each say what happens.

basic-save.meaning: A basic save against damage: half, full, double.

attack.meaning: A spell attack roll against AC: rays the module rolls, or pf2e's own attack resolving.

attack-then-save.meaning: A hit gives a save rather than damage; a critical hit makes the save worse.

second-save.meaning: One result forces a further save.

counteract.meaning: A counteract check against an effect, a condition or a teleport.

flat-check.meaning: A flat check gates an action.

maneuver.meaning: A combat maneuver rolled with another statistic, the caster against a DC.

attacker-saves.meaning: Whoever attacks the holder rolls first.
phrases: Creatures attempting to attack the target

degree-shift.meaning: A degree of success is raised or lowered after the roll.
phrases: turn a critical failure into a failure

roll-twice.meaning: Fortune or misfortune: roll twice, keep one.

caster-choice.meaning: The caster picks an option at the cast, and the rest follows from it.
phrases: When you Cast this Spell, choose

result-kept.meaning: A creature's first result stands for the rest of the casting.

effect.question: What changes on the sheet or the board?

damage.meaning: Damage, rolled from the card or by a rider.

damage-rolled-once.meaning: One damage roll for the whole cast, saved against once per creature.

weapon-dice.meaning: Damage dice taken from a held weapon: its die, its type, its critical specialization.

damage-on-miss.meaning: Part of the damage lands even when the attack fails.

persistent.meaning: Persistent damage, sometimes ending with something else.

condition.meaning: A pf2e condition, with or without a duration.

condition-climbs.meaning: A condition's value rises or falls each time, and something happens at the top.

condition-floor.meaning: A condition can't drop below a value while the spell holds.

forced-move.meaning: The creature is moved against its will.

push.meaning: Pushed away, or in a chosen direction, stopping at walls.

pull.meaning: Pulled toward a centre, nearest first, a square at a time.

elevation.meaning: The creature's height above the ground changes.

fall.meaning: Brought down safely, and kept down.
phrases: can't Fly, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground

lift.meaning: Raised, or moved up and down.

banish.meaning: Sent off the scene, perhaps to come back.

terrain.meaning: Difficult terrain, for everyone or only for some.

speed.meaning: A Speed granted, raised, lowered or freed from penalties.

fast-healing.meaning: Healing at the start of each of the holder's turns.
phrases: at the start of each of its turns

hp-transfer.meaning: Hit Points moved from one creature to another.
phrases: You lose as many Hit Points as

damage-split.meaning: A creature's damage is shared with another.

death.meaning: Killed outright, at 0 Hit Points or by a threshold.

backlash.meaning: Something happens afterwards depending on how the whole cast went.

hold.meaning: The creature is held and may Escape.

hazard.meaning: Held by a thing with its own AC and Hit Points that can be attacked.
phrases: Escape DC is equal to your spell DC

condition.meaning: A condition with an Escape against the spell DC.

escape-succeeds.meaning: The holder's Escapes succeed by themselves.

tether.meaning: A teleport or banishment of the holder is counteracted before it happens.
phrases: teleportation effect that would move the target
transport it to a different plane

affliction.meaning: An affliction with stages, a save at each turn end, and a maximum duration.

cleanse.meaning: An affliction's stage lowered, or the affliction counteracted.

suppress.meaning: An effect paused rather than ended, its clock stopped.

authored: an effect with a Weakness rule
an effect with a Resistance rule

sense.meaning: A sense granted, or a way of seeing what is hidden.

concealment.meaning: Concealed, by an area or on a creature.

reveal.meaning: Invisibility weakened to concealment, or concealment taken away.

light.meaning: A light set down, attached to a creature, or moved.

forbid.meaning: Actions of some traits refused while the effect lasts.

form.meaning: A battle form: new statistics, attacks and senses.
authored: an effect with a BattleForm rule
an effect with a CreatureSize rule

summon.meaning: A creature brought onto the board.

barrier.meaning: Sections with AC, Hardness and Hit Points that can be broken.
phrases: section of the wall has AC

cover.meaning: Cover from creatures on the other side.

intercept.meaning: Something takes a blow for an ally first.

shield.meaning: A shield to raise and block with.

decoy.meaning: Images that a hit may land on instead.

destroy.meaning: An object or a wall section destroyed.

weapon-runes.meaning: A weapon given runes for the duration.

authored: an effect with a Strike rule

gm-note.meaning: The part the table rules on, whispered to the GM rather than guessed.

damage-type.meaning: The damage type is chosen at the cast, taken from a held weapon, or changed by the target.
phrases: damage of the type you chose

trait-gained.meaning: A trait added to the spell, an item or a creature's Strikes while it lasts.

approach-barred.meaning: A creature can't move closer to the caster, or pays more to; moving away is free.

recast.meaning: A Sustain repeats the spell's own attack or effect, at the same rank.
phrases: Each time you Sustain the spell, you can

disarm.meaning: An item loosened in, or knocked from, the holder's grasp.

duration.meaning: A fixed duration, often set by the degree of the save.

next-turn.meaning: Until the start or end of the caster's next turn, or the target's.
phrases: until the start of your next turn
until the end of your next turn
until the end of its turn

sustained.meaning: Lasts only while the caster Sustains it.

save-ends.meaning: A new save, each turn, ends it.
authored: carries: a turn-end save with shorten: all
phrases: attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns

save-shortens.meaning: A new save, each turn, takes rounds off it.
authored: carries: a turn-end save with shorten

leaves-area.meaning: Ends when the holder leaves the area that gave it.

with-area.meaning: Ends when the area ends, wherever its holder is.

hostile-action.meaning: Ends when its holder uses a hostile action.

spent.meaning: Ends when what it gives is used up: a bonus spent, images gone, charges popped.
phrases: If the target uses the bonus

worn-down.meaning: Each hit or blow takes some of its duration.

permanent.meaning: Has no end of its own.

immunity-after.meaning: Afterwards the holder is immune to it for a while.
authored: an immunity effect, and a not: predicate on it

preparations.meaning: Lasts until the caster's next daily preparations.
phrases: until the next time you make your daily preparations

replaces-previous.meaning: A new casting ends the caster's earlier one, or one of several.
phrases: must choose one of the existing

dismiss.meaning: The caster, or the holder, can Dismiss it.

out-of-range.meaning: Ends when the two creatures it links move too far apart.
phrases: more than 30 feet away from you

zero-hp.meaning: Ends when a creature it involves reaches 0 Hit Points.

action-save.meaning: The holder spends an action on a save that ends the effect on itself.
authored: originAction with holder: true, a save, and expire
phrases: attempt to end the spell's effect on itself

scaling.question: What grows with rank or with actions?

dice-per-rank.meaning: Dice or a number that grows with each rank or each step of heightening.

from-rank.meaning: At a given rank something changes or is added.

per-action.meaning: The actions spent casting change the targets or the damage.
phrases: If you spend 2 or more actions

area-per-rank.meaning: A larger area at higher ranks.

level-cap.meaning: The level of creature it can affect rises with rank.

economy.question: What does it cost, limit or need?

once-per-round.meaning: Happens at most once a round, for a creature or for the spell.

charges.meaning: A counter that is spent, each use doing less or ending it at zero.

granted-action.meaning: The spell gives the caster or the holder an action to use later.
phrases: You can spend a single action

reaction.meaning: Cast or used as a reaction to a trigger.

attack-penalty.meaning: How it counts toward the multiple attack penalty.

requires.meaning: The cast needs something first: a held weapon, a flying target.

once-per-target.meaning: Works at most once for a given creature, or a given case of an affliction.
